report.explanation: Current evidence shows healthy signals: payment checkout span OK (71ms), gateway and order logs 200/ok, order error_rate 0.0014 with p95 79ms and no dependency timeouts. The gateway deployment (3.2.6, ~2582 min old) is only a version fact, not proof of causation. No current evidence substantiates the operator's deployment-caused checkout failure hypothesis, so hand off for more data.
missing_evidence: Checkout failure/error telemetry (5xx rates, failed spans) for the incident window to confirm failures exist
Payment service error/latency metrics beyond a single OK span
Gateway and order error-rate baselines before and after the 3.2.6 deployment to test deployment causality
Any evidence linking the gateway 3.2.6 deployment to checkout failures
